# Mental Health America

> > Mental Health America provides comprehensive mental health education, screening tools, research data, and advocacy resources to support mental wellness across the United States.

Mental Health America (MHA) is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to mental health awareness and advocacy. The site offers evidence-based educational content, screening tools, workplace wellness programs (including the Bell Seal certification), research reports with state-level data, and clinical trial resources to help individuals and communities understand and address mental health conditions.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health Conditions
- Screening Tools
- Mental Health Resources
- Workplace Wellness
- Bell Seal Certification
- Clinical Trials
- Mental Health Statistics
- Advocacy & Policy
- BIPOC Communities
- Mental Health Month
- State Mental Health Data
- Mental Health Learning Hub
- Crisis Support
- Research Reports
- Community Support

## Core Learning & Education

- [Mental Health Learning Hub](https://mhanational.org/mental-health-learning-hub): Comprehensive learning hub covering conditions, identity-based resources, and crisis services
- [Learn About Your Mental Health](https://mhanational.org/learn-about-your-mental-health): Mental health education hub with learning resources and screening tools
- [Mental Health Conditions Archive](https://mhanational.org/conditions): Archive of mental health conditions with symptoms and treatment information
- [Resources Archive](https://mhanational.org/resources): Archive of mental health resources, crisis information, and recovery guides

## Research & Data

- [The State of Mental Health in America](https://mhanational.org/the-state-of-mental-health-in-america): Annual state rankings and national mental health data with policy advocacy
- [Research and Reports](https://mhanational.org/research-and-reports): Mental health research reports, state data, and screening analytics
- [Data in Your Community](https://mhanational.org/data-in-your-community): Community-level mental health data dashboard and screening analytics
- [Quick Facts](https://mhanational.org/quick-facts): Mental health statistics and prevalence data from SAMHSA and NSDUH

## Workplace & Organizational Resources

- [Workplace Wellness Resources](https://mhanational.org/workplace): Workplace mental health resources and Bell Seal certification program

## Advocacy & Community Engagement

- [Advocacy & Policy](https://mhanational.org/advocacy-policy): Mental health policy advocacy and congressional action alerts
- [Get Involved](https://mhanational.org/get-involved): Ways to participate in advocacy, partnerships, and mental health equity
- [Become an Advocate](https://mhanational.org/become-an-advocate): Guide to mental health advocacy and legislative action participation
- [Mental Health Month](https://mhanational.org/mental-health-month): Mental Health Awareness Month campaign with action guides and resources

## Clinical Trials & Research Opportunities

- [Clinical Trial Resources](https://mhanational.org/clinical-trial-resources): Clinical trial information and research opportunities in mental health
- [Clinical Trials Archive](https://mhanational.org/clinical-trials): Archive of clinical trial resources and study directory

## Multilingual & Community-Specific Resources

- [Spanish-Language Homepage](https://mhanational.org/es): Spanish-language homepage for Mental Health America organization
- [Centro de Recursos de Salud Mental en Español](http://mhanational.org/recursos): Spanish-language mental health resources and support for BIPOC communities

## Optional

- [Home](https://mhanational.org): Mental Health America homepage with key products and advocacy initiatives
- [Donate](https://mhanational.org/donate): Donation page and fundraising information for Mental Health America
